name: indian-consumer-drafting
description: Open-source Claude-compatible plugin for drafting Indian consumer-protection and medical-negligence pleadings before the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions. Case-config-aware design — the plugin's structural skeletons are uniform across pleading types, and the parties' chosen Commission tier (District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission for claims up to ₹1 crore / State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission for claims of ₹1 crore to ₹10 crore / National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission for claims exceeding ₹10 crore), pecuniary jurisdiction, territorial jurisdiction, deficiency-of-service character, defect-in-goods character, unfair-trade-practice character, product-liability scheme, medical-negligence anchor (Jacob Mathew v State of Punjab / Martin F D'Souza / Kusum Sharma / Bolam standard via case-law), limitation anchor under Section 69, and accompanying-application set are supplied by the user via a case-config file. Drafting workflows for District Commission Complaint under Section 35, State Commission original Complaint under Section 47, NCDRC original Complaint under Section 58, Medical Negligence Complaint, Product Liability Action under Sections 82-87, Unfair Trade Practice Complaint, Appeal from District to State Commission under Section 41, Appeal from State Commission to NCDRC under Section 51, Revisional Application before NCDRC under Section 67, and Execution Application under Sections 71-72. Includes the 6-agent drafting pipeline (Reader -> Format -> Drafter -> Verifier -> Refiner -> Overseer), shared consumer drafting base with Consumer Protection Act 2019 + Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules 2020 + Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 + Sale of Goods Act 1930 + Indian Medical Council (Professional Conduct) Regulations 2002 + New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules 2019 + Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 + Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 discipline encoded.
